description:
`docs/contributing-results.md` was added in PR #53 but it is not linked
from the docs navigation, the README, or the explorer header. Phase 2
produces zero contributions if no one can find the door.

This item makes the contribution path discoverable from the three places
a prospective contributor will plausibly start: the explorer (which is
where they encounter results in the first place), the docs nav (where
they look for "how do I…"), and the repo README (where they land from
GitHub search). It also adds a homepage callout on the explorer landing
page once the corpus is large enough to make the call-to-action credible.

anti_patterns.dont: add the CTA before the corpus is broad enough to look credible
anti_patterns.why: inviting contributors to a sparse corpus invites questions about why their result would matter; sequence after `expand-seed-corpus-to-sf-0-1` lands.

anti_patterns.dont: create a separate landing page that duplicates the contributor guide
anti_patterns.why: it splits the source of truth and rots independently; surface the existing page from multiple entry points.

anti_patterns.dont: put the CTA card on every explorer page
anti_patterns.why: it becomes noise once the visitor is deep in a comparison; landing-only is sufficient.

preserves.behavior: Existing README structure and pitch (additive only - small new section).
Existing explorer header layout and styling (additive only).
The existing `docs/contributing-results.md` content (this TODO surfaces it, doesn't rewrite it).

verifications.description: Header component references the contributor guide
Sphinx toctree references the contributor guide
verifications.expected: at least one match in a toctree

work_units.notes:
Edit `results-explorer/src/components/Header.tsx` (or equivalent -
confirm the actual file). Add a nav link "Submit a result" pointing
to the contributor guide URL on benchbox.dev/docs/contributing-results.
Style consistently with existing nav items. Open in same tab.
work_units.summary: Add 'Submit a result' link to the explorer site header

work_units.notes:
Add a small card to the explorer landing page (after the summary
cards) inviting visitors to contribute their own results. Card title:
"Run BenchBox on your platform - submit your results". Link to
contributor guide. Include a one-line summary of the workflow
(run → submit → PR). Skip the card on benchmark/platform browse pages
(top-level landing only).
work_units.summary: Add a homepage CTA card on the explorer landing page

work_units.notes:
Edit `docs/index.rst` (or the appropriate Sphinx toctree) to include
`contributing-results` under a "Contributing" section. If a
"Contributing" toctree section doesn't exist, create one alongside
the existing top-level sections (Concepts, Platforms, etc.).
Confirm the page renders in `docs/_build/html/contributing-results.html`
after a local sphinx build.
work_units.summary: Add 'Contributing Results' to the docs nav

work_units.notes:
Add a short section after the existing "Quick Start" / installation
section. Two paragraphs maximum:
  1. The pitch (you can publish your own results in the public corpus)
  2. The link to the full guide
Match the README's existing voice. Do not duplicate the full guide
content here.
work_units.summary: Add a 'Contributing Results' section to README.md
